Watch the official trailer for Lucky Strike, the upcoming WWII action thriller starring Scott Eastwood, Colin Hanks, Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor and Taylor John Smith. The film follows a wounded American soldier trapped behind enemy lines during the Battle of the Bulge, forced to rely on a hand-radio, instinct and survival tactics to escape the advancing Nazi forces.
